page.layout: One column of names in the centre, with years printed in the left margin beside it. Two notes in the right margin, each beside the lines of 1350 and 1355. No running head. Page number at the top.

main_text.l: Alardus Wanig. Transactio civitatis Gron. cum Reinoldo Coverdio, & Drentinis,
1352 Ioan. Dunck F. Menoldi de Ham-
1355 Albertus Calmar. Foedus Groning, cum Stellenvverfiis,

page.notes: The years 1351 and 1357 stand beside lines with no name. The margin reading "Transfactio" is read as "Transactio", and "Stellenvverfiis" is uncertain. The "(borch." on the Hermannus Cater line is a fragment of a parenthesis and is kept as printed. The page number "18" is read at the top of the page and is uncertain.
